title: Sudden severe epigastric pain
stem: A 23-year-old man presents with sudden severe epigastric pain that began 6 hours ago. They have been taking regular ibuprofen for backache. The abdomen is rigid with generalised peritonism. HR 88, BP 110/74, Temp 37.9°C. An erect chest X-ray is pending.
suggested_questions: Any previous dyspepsia or ulcer disease?

title: Painful breast lump in lactating patient
stem: A 37-year-old lactating woman presents with a painful, erythematous right breast lump for 36 days. She is febrile. There is a fluctuant mass in the upper outer quadrant. HR 118, BP 97/63, Temp 38.9°C.
suggested_questions: Any nipple trauma or cracked skin?

title: Irreducible painful groin lump
stem: A 31-year-old woman presents with an irreducible painful right groin lump for 6 hours, now with vomiting. The lump is tender and there is no cough impulse. HR 93, BP 113/69, Temp 37.0°C.
suggested_questions: When was the lump last reducible?

title: Severe epigastric pain radiating to the back
stem: A 62-year-old woman with known gallstones presents with severe epigastric pain radiating to the back and vomiting for 48 hours. Abdomen is tender but soft. Lipase is markedly elevated. HR 103, BP 128/87, Temp 38.5°C.

title: Severe abdominal pain out of proportion
stem: A 57-year-old man with atrial fibrillation presents with sudden severe diffuse abdominal pain out of proportion to examination findings. Lactate is rising. HR 122, BP 128/75, Temp 37.7°C.

title: Post-operative wound swelling and fever
stem: A 60-year-old woman is day 24 after open appendicectomy and develops increasing wound pain, swelling and fever. The wound is erythematous with fluctuance. HR 111, BP 120/54, Temp 37.4°C.

title: Gradual unilateral scrotal pain
stem: A 78-year-old male presents with gradual onset left scrotal pain and swelling over 12 hours, with dysuria. Cremasteric reflex is present. HR 107, BP 106/88, Temp 38.4°C.

title: Left lower quadrant pain and fever
stem: A 52-year-old man presents with 12 hours of progressive left lower quadrant pain, low-grade fever and altered bowel habit. There is localised LLQ tenderness without generalised peritonism. HR 88, BP 97/86, Temp 38.2°C. WCC and CRP are raised.
key_features: CT to confirm and grade severity

title: Jaundice with fever and RUQ pain
stem: A 71-year-old woman presents with right upper quadrant pain, fever and jaundice for 48 hours. Murphy's sign is equivocal; they look septic. HR 111, BP 94/80, Temp 38.4°C. LFTs are cholestatic and WCC is raised.

title: Rapidly progressive limb pain after minor trauma
stem: A 73-year-old woman with diabetes presents with rapidly progressive pain in the leg after a minor scratch 24 hours ago. Pain is out of proportion; there is tense swelling and systemic toxicity. HR 92, BP 121/80, Temp 36.9°C.

title: Back pain and collapse in an older patient
stem: A 58-year-old man with hypertension develops sudden severe back/flank pain and a brief collapse. There is a pulsatile abdominal mass. HR 113, BP 107/87, Temp 38.8°C.
